Which change is a physical change? Explain.
Salt dissolving: no new substance; it can be recovered by evaporation.
A student says "a temperature change always means a chemical reaction". Evaluate this using the data.
Not always: dissolving ammonium nitrate is a physical change but cools by 14 °C. Look for other evidence such as a new substance or gas.
